title: Attrition record
description: What happens to the facts about one payment between the party that knows them and the tax authority's boundary. Five hops; at each, the fields and the pounds present by provenance class, and what the hop added, coarsened, realigned, dropped or delayed. Field names carry their hop as a prefix, so a name in any list says where it lives.
x-status: Version 0, written for a demonstrator on simulated data. Not an HMRC or Open Banking standard.

transactionId.description: The bank's identifier for the payment.

businessType.description: The business the payment posts to, or null when it posts to none.

hops.description: In order: originator-record, bank-rail, ledger-envelope, ledger-posting, hmrc-boundary.

numbersThatCanCross.description: How many numbers the update body can hold: 33 for self-employment, 16 for UK property, 0 when the payment posts to no business.

envelopeFieldsIn.description: How many fields the envelope held.

fieldsReached.description: The body fields this payment's pounds landed in.

fieldsByClass.description: Fields present at this hop, by provenance class.

poundsByClass.description: Money the fields at this hop state, in pence, by the class of the field that carries it. Figures can overlap: a gross and the fee inside it both count. The total says how much money each class of evidence states at the hop, not what the payment was worth.

added.description: Fields this hop introduced rather than carried from the hop before.

coarsened.description: Fields of the previous hop that this hop folded in with other lines' figures, or merged with another money field of the same line.

realigned.description: Fields placed in a different period from the date the payment carries.

dropped.description: Fields of the previous hop that nothing at this hop carries forward.

delayed.description: Fields that reached this hop later than the payment did; and fields of a line held open awaiting evidence.
